page.overview:
What is Ralpho?

is the main antagonist in Bunny Call, the first story in the book of the same name.

Ralpho is a tall rabbit-based character, being over six-and-a-half feet tall not including his floppy ears, which add at least an another foot. He has bright orange fur and wears a white-and-black checked vest, a yellow-and-white polka-dot bow tie, and a black top hat which his ears stick straight up out of. Ralpho holds a pair of cymbals. He has a big head said to be about the size of an exercise ball. Ralpho has bright pink eyes and furry orange paws, which bleed after being attacked by Bob Mackenzie. It’s unclear if he is a costume or an animatronic, although his bleeding suggests the former.

On the book's cover art, Ralpho appears much smaller. He wears a blue striped black hat. Ralpho has blushed, blue cheeks and buck teeth. He also has blue eyes. Unlike the usual animatronics Ralpho doesn't have a segmented body, further suggesting he may be costume rather than an animatronic.

Ralpho is used in what is known as a "Bunny Call", where he visits each cabin that has signed up for it on the first day at camp in the early morning hours between 5 and 6 AM. He bursts into each cabin while screaming, smashing his cymbals together and violently jerking his head around. This is supposed to energize children by providing an abrupt rush of terror. It isn't directly stated whether Ralpho is an animatronic or a costume, but because it lacks a segmented, jointed body it is presumably a costume.
